title: Portrait and Autopsy
author: Mirabel Almeida
blurb: Dominic Blackwood, the archivist of a cathedral with a locked crypt, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. But when twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
